title: Project on Tourism and Travel Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge and skills in designing, guiding, and managing travel programs through practical experience.
Demonstrate effective communication skills in working with suppliers and handling issues during travel programs.
Develop and execute project plans for travel programs, including budgeting and coordination with suppliers.
Show leadership in managing travel programs and handling unexpected situations.
Produce professional reports based on practical experiences.
Adhere to professional ethics and responsibilities in travel management.
Provide excellent customer service during travel programs.
Understand and respect local cultures and promote sustainable tourism practices.
Apply problem-solving skills in managing travel programs.
Work effectively in teams and coordinate with different groups.
Demonstrate ability to work independently in travel management tasks.
